B1_scalar_bounds.note: finite-difference value is a cross-check of the analytic expression (step 1e-6)

C2_isometry_parity.basis: odd-site mass is exactly zero in exact arithmetic; 1e-28 is (1e-14)^2, the square of the measured norm drift scale

D2_sign_and_shift.note: position means are taken on a ring with polynomial packet tails; reported, not thresholded

E1_rotation_primitive.note: 7 signed paths for column (3,4) plus 9 cancelling pairs; the 21/25 value holds only when all padding returns to the first rail

E3_exact_flight.note: float model is double precision; the difference is its rounding, reported not thresholded
